facts.fact: Namibia's Deputy Minister of Industrialization and Trade told the National Assembly that the Business and Intellectual Property Authority has collected beneficial ownership information as part of business registration since 7 August 2023, with 64,356 of 221,338 entities in the business register having submitted it by 30 June 2024.
